_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Screening against 14 sanctions and export-control lists

description: Screen a person or company name against 14 sanctions and export-control lists: OFAC SDN, OFAC Non-SDN, EU Financial Sanctions, UN Security Council, UK Sanctions List, Canada SEMA, Swiss SECO, Australia DFAT, BIS Denied Persons, BIS Entity List, BIS Unverified List, BIS Military End-User, ITAR Debarred and State Nonproliferation. Fuzzy name matching, so transliterations and spelling variants still surface. Returns the number of potential matches and the ten highest scoring, each with its score, list, program, aliases and addresses. A score is name similarity, not a finding that a match is the same party: confirm a date of birth, an address or an ID document before acting on it. Free, no account, 25 screenings a day from each internet address, shared by screen_entity and screen_address; in ChatGPT, each user has their own 25. A screening is not recorded and produces no document: its report_url opens the same search on ofacscreen.com, where a timestamped PDF record of it can be bought. The price is in report_price. Calling this tool is free. Searched only when named in lists: UAE Local Terrorist List, UFLPA Entity List, FBI Most Wanted, FinCEN Special Measures, France Registre des gels, Israel NBCTF crypto wallets, Japan MOF, Mexico SAT 69-B, Poland MSWiA.

email.description: The party's email address, checked against the ones the lists record. Optional; up to 5 separated by commas or semicolons.

lists.description: List codes to search instead of the default 14. Omit to search the default lists.

name.description: Full name of the person or entity to screen, e.g. "Vladimir Petrov" or "Acme Trading LLC". Up to 300 characters.

phone.description: The party's phone number, checked against the ones the lists record. Optional; up to 5 separated by commas or semicolons.

website.description: The party's website, checked against the ones the lists record. Optional; up to 5 separated by commas or semicolons.

name: screen_entity
title: Sanctions screening (OFAC SDN + 13 more lists)
